target: 并且只恳求允许他们对两位年轻人进行一次测试，以证明谁才是真正的王子。国王因对自己对心爱妻子发怒感到十分羞愧，立刻同意了。她说道，毫无疑问，别人会让他们骑马或射箭，或做些类似的事情，但这些技能人人都会学。
source_full: And only begged to be allowed to put a test to the two young men to prove which was the real prince. The king, who was feeling much ashamed of the rage he had been in with his dear wife, consented at once, and she said No doubt others would make them ride or shoot, or something of that sort, But every one learns these things.
